data.exact_reserve_text: Unfavourable development of GBP 37.9m (2018 favourable development of GBP 1.7m) on prior accident year losses. The unfavourable development was driven by attritional claims and claims expenses following a deep dive on the Casualty book in relation to a small number of historical contracts that are now in run-off.

named_events.loss_description: Impact of GBP 31.7m from the 2019 catastrophe events (Typhoon Faxai, Typhoon Hagibis and Hurricane Dorian)

data.standardized_narrative: Gross claims reserves showed overall adverse development: on a gross basis the development on prior years amounted to a strengthening of approximately GBP 59.6m (about 6.2% of opening gross claims outstanding). Management reports an unfavourable net prior-year development of GBP 37.9m, driven principally by adverse/attritional development and increased claims expenses following a detailed review of the Casualty book and a small number of historical contracts now in run-off. Separately, 2019 catastrophe events (Typhoon Faxai, Typhoon Hagibis and Hurricane Dorian) produced a net 2019 catastrophe impact of GBP 31.7m.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development (gross) was computed from the gross claims development triangle (notes) because the narrative statement in the managing agent's report appears to quote a net figure (GBP 37.9m adverse). The triangle was used to derive a gross PYD of +GBP 59.558m. 'Earlier' aggregate column in the triangle was excluded per rules. No explicit 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' gross figure was provided in a single movement note. No RITC (Reinsurance to Close) was evident in the notes to distort the triangle. Some narrative figures (e.g. GBP 37.9m) are net of reinsurance; where only net figures were quoted, gross was derived from the triangle.
